editPlan.notes: Device mapping: template Z axis -> Vertical_Shuttle (1 ret sensor + extend timer), template X axis -> Horizontal_Shuttle (retract sensor only, extend confirmed by new HorizontalShuttleExtendDelay), template gripper -> Hold_Down (retract sensor i_HoldDownRetracted reuses the freed i_XAxisExtended point, extend confirmed by HoldDownExtendDelay), new Top_Retainer device added (extend timer 300 ms + retract sensor). Retry of magnet presentation uses DINT MagnetRetryCount (3 tries) with escalation to state 28 (unclamp / lower / request next stack). Only the 7 existing alarm slots are used so every message string could be authored with setStringData: Alarm[0] is the warning+pause covering all three partner waits (states 4, 19, 25), Alarm[3]/Alarm[6] were re-purposed from the sensor-misconfigured slots to Hold Down / Top Retainer move failures. Alarm[i].Message runtime prefix comes from g_StationList (controller scope, law) - update g_StationList[1] text from 'S01 Part Load' to 'S01 Magnet Feed'. All three cross-station handshakes (Dial_Index index complete, Magnet_Pick magnet taken / request new / gave up) are engineer placeholders per Rule 8.

S01 Magnet_Feed - feeds magnets one at a time from the indexed stack to the pick station. Hold_Down clamps the stack, Vertical_Shuttle lifts it, Horizontal_Shuttle presents the top magnet coin-changer style, Top_Retainer holds the magnet down during every horizontal shuttle move. Presentation retries 3x on missing magnet (MagnetRetryCount), then unclamps, lowers the shuttle and requests the next stack from Dial_Index (p_RequestNextStack). p_MagnetPresented feeds Magnet_Pick one magnet at a time on demand; if the pick loses a magnet a fresh one is presented, if the pick gives up the stack is released.
